# Description

Each QPress simulation runs until it produces 10,000 stable matrices. The object produced by QPress' `system.simulate` records the total number of matrices produced to reach 10,000 stable ones. 

Compare the % total matrices that were stable (**"% stable matrices"**) across operating model scenarios (OMs) x management strategies (HCRs).

Hypothesis: The OMs / HCRs which showed the least agreement between the quantitative MSE and QNMs will have the lowest % matrices that were stable.  



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(QPress)
library(PNWColors)

## let's time things
end.timer <- function(s){round(Sys.time()-s,2)}

## read in which version of the data from qpress?
sim.date <- '20240923' 

```

## R Markdown

## Data

Read in the output from perturbations
`system.simulate` output should have been saved as lists from qnm_mse_master.R
```{r load_sims, echo=TRUE}
s <- Sys.time()


hcrA_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrA_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrB_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrB_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrC_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrC_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrD_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrD_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrE_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrE_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))

hcr_out_all <- list(hcrA_out,hcrB_out,hcrC_out,hcrD_out,hcrE_out)
names(hcr_out_all) <- c("A","B","C","D","E")


end.timer(s)
```

Read in the counts of mismatched qual v quant results.
```{r echo=TRUE}
compare_df <- read_csv(here('data','results','qnmVmse_mismatches_byOMbyHCR20240923.csv'))
```

Read in the qualitative outcomes from the QNMs, so we can count equivocal results.
```{r}
qnm_out <- read_csv(here('data','results','qnm0-5_hcra-e_qualitative_20240923.csv'))
```



## stability & mismatched results

What is the overall distribution of proportion stable matrices?
```{r}
for(i in 1:length(hcr_out_all)){
  
  tmp.stable <- sapply(hcr_out_all[[1]],function(x){x$stable/x$total})
  
  if(i==1){
    stable.df <- data.frame(ms=rep(names(hcr_out_all)[i],length.out=length(tmp.stable)),
                            om=names(tmp.stable),
                            pstable=as.numeric(tmp.stable))
  } else{ stable.df %<>% bind_rows(data.frame(ms=rep(names(hcr_out_all)[i],length.out=length(tmp.stable)),
                            om=names(tmp.stable),
                            pstable=as.numeric(tmp.stable)))}
}

ggplot(stable.df,aes(x=pstable)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=50) + theme_bw()
```


Break down by OM/MS: Is the stability of OM 5 (had the most mismatches between the quantitative MSE and the QNMs)
```{r}
ggplot(stable.df,aes(x=om,y=pstable)) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.15,height=0, aes(col=ms)) + 
  labs(x='operating model', y='proportion matrices stable') +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
```

wild! so OM 4 (offshore inaccessible biomass because of climate change) was the least stable, while OM 2 (Thorson effort) was the most stable. 

This is not what I expected!

Does % mismatches trend with % stable matrices?
```{r}
compare_df %<>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('A','B','C','D','E'), names_to="MS", values_to="n_mismatch") %>%
  mutate(p_mismatch=n_mismatch/4)

compare_df %>%
  left_join(stable.df %>%
              rename(om_name=om) %>%
              mutate(om=substr(om_name,4,4)) %>%
              mutate(om=ifelse(om=="O",as.double("0"),as.double(om))),
            by=c("MS"="ms","OM"="om")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=pstable,y=p_mismatch)) +
  geom_point(aes(col=om_name)) + 
  facet_wrap(~model.y) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
png(here('doc','supplement','figC1-StabilityVMismatches.png'), res=300, height=1000,width=1850)
compare_df %>%
  mutate(model.y=case_when(model.y=='MSE-Species1' ~ 'Species 1',
                           model.y=='MSE-Species2' ~ 'Species 2')) %>%
  left_join(stable.df %>%
              rename(om_name=om) %>%
              mutate(om=substr(om_name,4,4)) %>%
              mutate(om=ifelse(om=="O",as.double("0"),as.double(om)),
                     om_name=ifelse(om_name=="OM O", "OM 0 Status Quo",om_name)),
            by=c("MS"="ms","OM"="om")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=pstable,y=p_mismatch)) +
  geom_point(aes(col=om_name), alpha=0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~model.y) +
  labs(x='proportion matrices stable',y='proportion metrics mismatched') +
  scale_color_discrete(type=pnw_palette(name="Starfish",n=5,type="discrete"), name='Operating Model') +
  theme_bw()
dev.off()
```


## stability & equivocal QNM output

The OM with the least stability will probably have the most equivocal outcomes for metrics?...

```{r}
qnm_out %<>% pivot_longer(cols=4:7, names_to='metric', values_to='qual_out') %>%
  group_by(`Operating model`,`Management strategy`) %>%
  mutate(n_tot=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(`Operating model`,`Management strategy`, n_tot,qual_out) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  mutate(p_tot=n/n_tot)
```

```{r}
qnm_out %>% filter(qual_out=="Equiv") %>%
  mutate(OM=substr(`Operating model`,1,1),
         MS=substr(`Management strategy`,1,1)) %>%
  left_join(stable.df %>%
              rename(om_name=om) %>%
              mutate(om=substr(om_name,4,4)) %>%
              mutate(om=ifelse(om=="O","0",om)),
            by=c("OM"="om","MS"="ms")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=pstable,y=p_tot)) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.005,height=0.005,aes(pch=MS,col=OM)) +
  theme_bw()
```

hmm. nope.
